candidates.angle: Sanjaya's final verdict on victory and justice

angle_en: Right action carries its own victory.

en.next: Here the Gita comes to rest.
en.notice: Sanjaya's closing verdict: where Krishna and Arjuna stand together, prosperity, victory, glory and justice follow.
en.meaning: Where Krishna, the master of yoga, is present, and where Arjuna, the bow-bearer, is present, there are prosperity, victory, glory, and firm justice. This is my conviction.

hi.meaning: जहाँ योगेश्वर भगवान् श्रीकृष्ण हैं और जहाँ गाण्डीवधनुषधारी अर्जुन हैं, वहाँ ही श्री, विजय, विभूति और अचल नीति है ऐसा मेरा मत है ॥

en.body: Where Krishna, the master of yoga, is present, and where Arjuna, the bow-bearer, is present, there are prosperity, victory, glory, and firm justice. This is my conviction. Sanjaya's closing verdict: where Krishna and Arjuna stand together, prosperity, victory, glory and justice follow. Here the Gita comes to rest.

hi.body: जहाँ योगेश्वर भगवान् श्रीकृष्ण हैं और जहाँ गाण्डीवधनुषधारी अर्जुन हैं, वहाँ ही श्री, विजय, विभूति और अचल नीति है ऐसा मेरा मत है ॥ यहीं गीता पूर्ण होती है।
